newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No more MIM management changes - CEO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No more MIM management changes - CEO.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd chief executive Nick Stump said on Wednesday he did not expect any more management changes following the resignation on Tuesday of Phil Wright, MIM executive general manager at the group's Mt Isa operations.
"I don't see any more changes in management. We now have eight instead of 12 managers. We're talking about very significant responsibilities," Stump told Reuters.
He described Wright's departure as a "confluence of events" in the middle of a major restructuring programme.

Stump said there was no foundation to market speculation that Wright's resignation followed differences of opinion on the company's future direction and the role of the core Mt Isa base metals operations.
"We are restructuring and I needed a commitment (from Wright) for the next two to three years. I did not expect him to stay another two to three years," he said.
"Also we are now in a building phase at Mt Isa. The (manager's) job has changed from reformer to operator-builder," Stump said.
Stump said his objectives for MIM remained the same as when he joined the company as chief executive in April, 1995.
"We have streamlined both marketing and refining and have a mine-to-market philosophy in both metals and coal," he said.
MIM previously had a lot of products that were not viable in world markets.
Continued efforts at simplifying the product range was also aiding MIM's efforts to become internationally competitive, Stump said.
